title: OpenClaw for Marketing Teams: 8 Content Workflows Running 24/7
summary: How marketing teams use OpenClaw to automate content research, competitive monitoring, newsletter drafts, social scheduling, and campaign reporting — without adding headcount.
body_markdown: A 5-person marketing team typically spends 40-60 hours/month on mechanical tasks (research, assembly, reporting, monitoring). OpenClaw automates 50-60% of that. At $80/hr loaded cost, that's $1,600-2,800/month saved. Blink Claw costs from about $45/month per agent plus model usage billed from your workspace credits. The payback period is the first week.
